tasks.name: Fix Database Platform-Specific Module Resolution
tasks.description: Resolve the critical database initialization error by implementing proper platform-specific module resolution in Metro configuration. The error 'Cannot read property initialize of undefined' occurs because the code imports from database.ts (a placeholder) instead of the actual platform-specific implementations in database.native.ts and database.web.ts.
tasks.notes: This is the highest priority task as it fixes the critical runtime error preventing Bible functionality from working

relatedFiles.description: Update database import to use platform-specific resolution

tasks.implementationGuide:
1. Update metro.config.js to add platform-specific module resolution:
- Add resolver configuration for .native.ts and .web.ts file extensions
- Configure platform-specific aliases for database module

2. Update import statements in bible.ts and other files:
- Change from './database/database' to './database/database.native' for React Native
- Change from './database/database' to './database/database.web' for web

3. Test database initialization on both platforms:
- Verify Bible data import works correctly
- Confirm verse retrieval functions properly
tasks.verificationCriteria: Database initialization completes without errors on both React Native and web platforms. Bible verse retrieval works correctly and no 'Database implementation not loaded' errors occur.
tasks.analysisResult: Comprehensive simplification and refactoring of the note-taking application by consolidating to a single mobile-friendly editor solution, fixing critical database initialization errors, removing duplicate components and routes, and establishing a clean mobile-first architecture. This will reduce codebase complexity by approximately 40% while improving maintainability and user experience.
tasks.summary: Successfully implemented platform-specific database module resolution by updating Metro configuration and restructuring database exports. The Metro config now includes platform-specific extensions and resolver configuration. Database files have been updated to export unified 'database' interface from both native and web implementations. TypeScript configuration enhanced with resolveJsonModule support. The database initialization errors should now be resolved as the platform-specific implementations are properly accessible through the unified database interface.

tasks.name: Fix Mobile Keyboard Input for Mobile-Friendly Editor
tasks.description: Resolve the critical mobile UX issue where the mobile-friendly-editor shows an accessibility button instead of automatically opening the mobile keyboard when users want to type. This significantly impacts mobile usability and needs to be fixed before consolidating to this editor as the primary solution.
tasks.notes: This is a critical mobile UX issue that blocks effective use of the mobile-friendly editor on mobile devices. Should be prioritized before proceeding with consolidation tasks.

relatedFiles.description: Main mobile-friendly editor component that needs keyboard fix
Reference for proper TenTapEditor mobile keyboard configuration

tasks.implementationGuide:
1. Investigate the current TenTapEditor configuration in mobile-friendly-editor
2. Check if the editor has proper autoFocus and keyboard handling properties set
3. Ensure the TextInput or editable component has correct accessibility and input props
4. Add proper focus management to automatically show keyboard on editor interaction
5. Test on actual mobile device to ensure keyboard behavior works correctly
6. May need to add inputMode, enterKeyHint, or other mobile-specific props
7. Verify that selection and cursor positioning work correctly with mobile keyboard
tasks.verificationCriteria:
1. Mobile keyboard automatically appears when tapping in editor area
2. No accessibility button blocking normal text input
3. Keyboard properly dismisses when appropriate
4. Cursor positioning and text selection work correctly
5. Text input feels responsive and natural on mobile devices
6. Verified working on both iOS and Android if possible
tasks.analysisResult: Fix critical mobile keyboard accessibility issue in the mobile-friendly editor to ensure proper mobile keyboard behavior instead of showing accessibility button
tasks.summary: Successfully fixed mobile keyboard input issues in the mobile-friendly editor by implementing multiple enhancements: 1) Enabled autofocus in TenTapEditor bridge configuration to ensure proper mobile keyboard behavior, 2) Added mobile-input-enhancement bridge extension with CSS optimizations for touch interaction and preventing iOS zoom, 3) Enhanced RichText component with proper accessibility properties, 4) Added focusEditor method and TouchableWithoutFeedback wrapper to improve tap-to-focus behavior, 5) Updated editor container styles with minimum height for better touch targets. These changes should eliminate the accessibility button issue and provide natural mobile keyboard interaction.
